mapper.select: /** podMapper.selectOrderMultiList */ SELECT od.HBL_NO as hblNo ,od.PO_NO as poNo ,od.OD_JOB_NO as odjobno ,od.DELIVERY_CODE as deliveryCode ,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 ,od.DEST_PORT ,od.BOUND ,teom.DELIVERY_NO as deliveryNo ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(teom.OD_JOB_NO,'') != '' THEN 'multi' ELSE 'N' END multi_chk ,teom.SEQ_NO_ID as chkSeq ,teom.DELIVERY_CODE as multiChangeDeliveryCode ,teom.RETURN_DELIVERY_NO as returnDeliveryNo ,teom.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED as deliveryNoChanged ,teom.SEQ_NO_ID as seqNoId FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI teom ON od.OD_JOB_NO = teom.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
